sentences.text: Shri M.A. Mansoori, learned counsel for the petitioner.
Heard on the question of admission.

The petitioner has filed the present petition being aggrieved by the order 29.05.2018 by which he has been placed under suspension and order dated 02.07.2018 by which leanred Commissioner has declined to grant the interim injunction.
The petitioner has assailed the said order mainly on the ground that he has been placed under suspension in exercise of power conferred under Section 39(1) (A) of the M.P. Panchayat Raj Avam Gram Swaraj Adhiniyam, 1993.

entities.text: M.P. Panchayat Raj Avam Gram Swaraj Adhiniyam, 1993
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The aforesaid provision is applicable only in respect of charges under the prevention of adulteration of food stuff and drugs suppression of immoral traffic in women and children, protection of civil rights and prevention of corruption etc and that too after framing of charges.

It appears from the contents of order dated 29.05.2018 that the petitioner has been placed under suspension only on the ground of registration of case under Section 34 of the Excise Act and his detention in the Central Jail.

The Commissioner has not considered the aforesaid provisions of law and declined in mechanical way, hence, the operation of order dated 29.05.2018 (Annexure P/2) shall remain stayed during the pendency of the appeal before the Commissioner.
The Commissioner is directed to decide the pending appeal of the petitioner within two months on its merits.
(VIVEK RUSIA) JUDGE Jasleen Prahlad Singh vs Panchayat And Rural Development ... on 24 July, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/127050880/
